dog.description_text:
Looking to add some flavor to your life? Kimchi is ready to spice things up! This handsome, 32-pound bundle of energy has a big smile, tons of charm, and will make every day feel like an absolute adventure.

Kimchi is a social butterfly who loves meeting new people! He's quite the talented guy, able to sit for treats, shake paw, walk on a leash, and ride well in a car.

Just under 2 years old, Kimchi is at a great age to explore the world and sniff out his next adventure! Whether you're heading out for a neighborhood stroll or cuddling on the couch at home, Kimchi is ready to make every day a little more fun.

Registered adopters interested in Kimchi can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more information. Not registered yet? Do it today at hbrdogs.com!
